content: In #39488, I generalize docs#HasFDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse etc to the case if the composition is differentiable, not necessarily the identity map. While the PR is not polished yet (needs docs, some lemmas use f and g in swapped roles etc), it would be nice to get a "quick opinion" review on what variations of these lemmas should and should not go to the PR. E.g., is it enough to have _of_leftInverse, or should I specialize to the cases of ContinuousLinearMap.IsInvertible and/or ContinuousLinearEquiv? Should I add all the different *comp variants around deriv (comp, scomp etc), or should we postpone this until someone needs it?

Motivation: I'm going to use the deriv version to show that a continuous branch of the complex square root of a differentiable function is differentiable, which is needed for the Riemann mapping theorem.
